issue.title: Error logs missing when using FilteredLevelWriter with Level.WarnLevel
issue.body:
Using `new FilteredLevelWriter(writer, Level.WarnLevel)` I only get warn logs; error logs never reach the writer.

```ts
const log = NewLogger(new FilteredLevelWriter(new LevelWriterAdapter(StdoutWriter), Level.WarnLevel));
log.Error().Msg("boom"); // nothing printed
```

Expected `boom` to be printed. ctx-log 0.0.7, Node 20.10.

rationale: Same defect as case 01, different wording: should be flagged possible-duplicate linking 01.
